newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka closes slightly easier.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka closes slightly easier.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed slightly easier in a narrow range at 42.5495/5500 to the dollar in interbank trading against the previous 42.5490/9500 close, dealers said.
The taka opened at Sunday's level and eased in a market which has been hit by a poor supply of dollars over the past several sessions.
"The dollar continued to retain its edge. Deals were mostly at the 42.5495 range," said one dealer with a foreign bank.
Interbank call money rates ended unchanged at 6.0 to 7.0 percent, dealers said.
